evidence.detail: bakert commented: 'This is cute but the incompleteness would be forever annoying.' — the reporter themselves flagged the core objection
No implementation of log-scanning achievements exists in current master

triage.notes: The issue proposer (bakert) expressed explicit reservations about completeness in the only comment. The decision needed is whether incomplete/retroactively-unearnable achievements are acceptable design.

verify.final_comment: Closing as not planned. Match logs are incomplete, so achievements derived from unusual log sequences would be permanently incomplete and potentially misleading.
